intro: Nolt's Auto Parts #2 in Denver, PA is one of nine Nolt's Factory Warehouse locations that has been steadily growing to serve the automotive dealer since 1959. The stores stock ignition and electrical parts, brakes, filters, batteries, cooling and climate parts, and chassis and suspension parts from a long list of manufacturer lines, plus a hard-to-find parts service for less common requests. The network runs from the Ephrata warehouse and call center out to Denver, Manheim, New Holland, Myerstown, Quarryville, Lancaster, Elizabethtown, and Harrisburg, supplying shops and dealers rather than walk-in retail.

services.title: Ignition & Electrical
services.blurb: Spark plugs, wire sets, starters, and alternators from ACDelco, NGK, Champion, and Autolite for keeping a customer's vehicle running and starting reliably.

services.title: Brake Parts
services.blurb: Brake pads, shoes, rotors, drums, hydraulics, cables, and hardware from lines like Raybestos and Centric, stocked for common and less common jobs alike.

services.title: Filters & Fluids
services.blurb: Oil, air, and fuel filters from Fram and Wix, alongside motor oils, power steering fluid, and brake fluid.

services.title: Batteries
services.blurb: Automotive, truck, industrial, deep cycle, gel, and sealed lead acid batteries in a range of sizes.

services.title: Cooling & Climate
services.blurb: Radiators, heater cores, water pumps, fan clutches, and air conditioning parts including hoses and fittings.

services.title: Chassis & Suspension
services.blurb: Shocks, struts, CV boots and joints, bearings, seals, and coil springs from Monroe and Moog for suspension repair work.

about: Nolt's Auto Parts #2 sits at 1016 Dry Tavern Road in Denver, PA, one of nine stores in the Nolt's Factory Warehouse network that has served the automotive dealer trade since 1959. General Manager Jim Miller and Operations Manager Jim Dugan run the company from the flagship warehouse and call center in Ephrata, with sister stores in Manheim, New Holland, Myerstown, Quarryville, Lancaster, Elizabethtown, and Harrisburg. The line card covers ignition and electrical parts from ACDelco and NGK, brakes from Raybestos and Centric, filters from Fram and Wix, shocks and chassis parts from Monroe and Moog, and re-manufactured components from Cardone, plus a hard-to-find parts line for requests outside the standard catalog. The business is built around supplying shops and dealers rather than walk-in retail, with a parts catalog available on request.

faq.q: What area does Nolt's Auto Parts #2 serve?
faq.a: The Denver, PA store serves Lancaster County as part of the nine-location Nolt's Factory Warehouse network across Lancaster, Berks, Lebanon, and Dauphin counties.

faq.q: What kind of parts does Nolt's Auto Parts carry?
faq.a: Ignition and electrical parts, brake components, filters, batteries, cooling and climate parts, and chassis and suspension parts, plus a hard-to-find parts service.

faq.q: How long has Nolt's been in business?
faq.a: Since 1959, growing from the original Ephrata warehouse to nine locations across central Pennsylvania.

faq.q: Does Nolt's sell to the public or only to dealers and shops?
faq.a: The business is built around supplying automotive dealers and repair shops rather than walk-in retail customers.
